verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers business banking and a Money Dashboard, so a universal finance search bar is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents searching across transactions, vendors, and cards from one bar, or jumping from search results into initiating a payment. The Money Dashboard is a cash-flow overview, not a search feature, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
